16533.d: The Lumbridge Swamp Caves is a cave system located underneath the Lumbridge Swamp.

gt.heading: Getting to the caves
gt.text:
The main entrance to the caves is through the Lumbridge Swamp, located south of Lumbridge. It is located in the centre of the swamp with a icon on the minimap. A rope is required when using this entrance for the first time. The Water altar is near this entrance.

Another route is through the basement of Lumbridge Castle, as the tunnels between the castle and the Dorgesh-Kaan mine also deviate towards the Swamp Caves, directly south from the tunnel entrance in the castle basement. The route between the tunnels and the Swamp Caves is initially blocked and needs to be mined. The Lost Tribe is required to access the tunnels and thus access the Swamp Caves from this direction.

A final route is via teleporting to the Tears of Guthix cavern with a games necklace then heading north.

gt.heading: Ceremonial travelling clothes
gt.text:
The suit to enter the land of dreams is composed of eight items: helm, torso, legs, gloves, boots, cape, amulet, and ring. Talk to the Oneiromancer about how to obtain each of the eight items. They can be obtained in any order.

Lunar helm

With any pickaxe, head north-east on the isle to find the Lunar Isle Mine, marked with a dungeon symbol on the minimap. Enter the mine through the small shack, and mine one of the grey stalagmites in the western part of the mine (next to the walls) to get a lunar ore.

Refine the ore by smelting it at any furnace (there is one in the house on the southern side of the village, next to the well; forges do not work, neither does Superheat Item), then smith the resulting lunar bar into a lunar helm on the anvil located in the same house.

Lunar cape

Travel back to the village, and talk with Pauline Polaris, in a house in the north-west corner of the village. She wants you to guess her real name before she gives you the Lunar cape:
• First, choose Pauline. She tells you that is her alias, and gives you a clue:
• Change a letter from the word Dane to get my first name
• The first part of my surname rhymes with wood
• The third part rhymes with spade
• And the second rhymes with magic
• Only one name fits those clues, Jane Blud-Hagic-Maid.

After you have guessed correctly, she gives you the lunar cape.

Lunar amulet

Talk to Meteora (she is in the south-west part of the village, by the house next to the L-shaped room with the water icon). She asks you to retrieve the tiara she lost to the suqahs.

Kill suqahs until one drops a special tiara (collect four suqah hides now if you haven't already, as you need them in the next step), and then go back to Meteora and trade her tiara for the lunar amulet.

Lunar torso, legs, gloves, and boots

Speak with Rimae Sirsalis, who runs the Moon Clan Fine Clothes shop, across from the bank about ceremonial clothes. Speak to her again about ceremonial clothes and she will offer to tan the suqah hides for you. She can tan suqah hides for 100 coins each. Have her tan the four suqah hides you got earlier. Buy a spool of thread (if you don't have it), and make the lunar torso, trousers (legs), gloves, and boots.

If you attempt to make a second set of lunar torso/legs/gloves/boots, you will receive the message, "You already have the ... part of the ceremonial clothes." This occurs whether the first set is in your backpack or your bank, or in the magic wardrobe in your player-owned house, and it is not possible to drop the clothes without destroying them.

Lunar ring

Talk with Selene, near the centre of the village (in or around one of the buildings near the locked Lunar Isle lodestone). She believes that her grandfather, an archaeologist, may have buried a lunar ring nearby. She gives you a clue to finding the ring: "From water's source you should follow, crossing the western-most bridge and travelling further south-westerly to a bloom of blue."

The "water source" seems to be the village well, spilling out to the ocean. Grab a spade, and go out the eastern gate of the village. You will again pass by the aggressive suqahs. Travel south-east until you reach a bridge. Cross it, then cross the bridge to the west right next to it. Keep heading west until you see a patch of blue flowers. The spot is west of the broken dock, 4 steps north of the anchor, between the tall blue flower and the small blue flower. Dig and you will obtain the lunar ring.

Do not have a clue scroll in your inventory requiring you to dig while obtaining the ring. | + Lunar ring location | |

16569.d: Lunar Isle is an island shaped like a crescent moon, located in the westernmost point of Gielinor.

gt.heading: Getting to Lunar Isle
gt.text:
Players have several ways to reach the isle.

Teleportation

Players can use the following means of teleportation to reach the isle:
• The Lunar Isle lodestone once they have activated
• The astral altar teleport
• The spells Moonclan Teleport and Tele-group Moonclan
• A Ring of Wealth's teleport to Miscellania and then travelling to Rellekka (requires Throne of Miscellania quest to be completed)
• A seal of passage, which has 1 free teleport charge per day

Walking

A seal of passage is not required for this transportation method, however, you must have completed The Fremennik Trials to board the ship.
# Talk to Lokar on the westernmost dock of Rellekka, who will take the player to Pirates' Cove. Without a seal of passage, players can lie to Lokar and say they're only going to Pirates' Cove, then proceed to Lunar Isle, anyway.
# Board the pirate ship, and talk to Captain Bentley to go on to Lunar Isle.

Fairy rings

A seal of passage is not required for this transportation method. It is not needed for players teleporting to the isle.
# Fairy ring CIP to Miscellania, walk south-east to the dock, and ride the southernmost boat to Rellekka.
# Fairy ring AJR to the Fremennik Slayer Dungeon , walk north-west to Rellekka.

16634.d: The Mage Arena is a minigame for members in which the player must travel to the Mage Arena in the deep Wilderness and fight Kolodion, the master of battle magic.
16634.loc: North of Lava Maze, West of Deserted Keep

gt.heading: Getting there
gt.text:
• Pull the Wilderness teleport lever in Ardougne or Edgeville, slash through the web to the north and run west to the arena.
• Use a Wilderness sword 4 to teleport to the Wilderness Agility Course, then run north-east.
• Use a portable obelisk, obelisk shard or Ghorrock Teleport (or tablet) to teleport to level 44 Wilderness, run north past the gate and then north-east.
• Use a Slayer cape to teleport to Mandrith, then run east.

To go into the Mage Arena bank, enter the building just north-west of the arena, slash the two webs and pull the lever.

16641.d: The Mage Training Arena is an area and its eponymous minigame that focuses on the magic skill.

gt.heading: Getting there
gt.text:
There are several quick ways of getting to the arena:
• Mystical sand seed and running east.
• Archaeology journal teleport and running south-east.
• Fairy ring teleport to BIP and running south-west.
• Wicked hood teleport to the Fire altar and running north-east.
• A Ring of duelling teleport to Het's Oasis, then going north, north-east.
• Home Teleport to the Al Kharid lodestone and going north east.
• Dungeoneering cape teleport to Al Kharid resource dungeon and then running east.
